- Added copyright notice: "Copyright © PatSnap. All rights reserved."
- No other functional or content changes.

Initial release introducing the “understand-technology” skill.

- Provides structured, technical explanations of materials science and engineering technologies.
- Supports queries about material properties, structure–property relationships, processing methods, and performance mechanisms.
- Answers begin with a concise high-level summary, followed by in-depth, sectioned analysis.
- Incorporates real-world context, key examples, and tables for clarity.
- Highlights both scientific principles and engineering implementation details.
- Includes ecosystem contributors, as well as advantages, limitations, and trade-offs.
